title: cinnamomum scrobiculatum
intro: Cinnamomum scrobiculatum, commonly known as Rakta Chandana, is a plant species belonging to the family Lauraceae. It is traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine for its numerous health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Cinnamomum scrobiculatum include wound healing, antiseptic, and antifungal activities, making it a valuable resource for treating various ailments. The bioactive constituents of this plant include various compounds like flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
